I. Mutinous Meerut sepoys break open the cantonment jail
II. Meerut sepoys cross the Yamuna and arrive at Delhi's Red Fort
III. Execution of Mangal Pandey at Barrackpore
IV. Proclamation of Bahadur Shah Zafar as Emperor of Hindustan

(B) I
(C) II
(D) IV
